description: Customers build an order from several products, then pay for it or cancel it.
data: products with a name (unique), a price and the number in stock
orders with who placed them, a status (open, paid or cancelled) and the total price
order items: a product and a quantity in an order, with the price per unit
actions: customers add products to an order and remove them
customers see their orders and an order's items
rules: customers can only see and change their own orders
items can only be added or removed while the order is open
nobody can order more than is in stock, and items in an order are taken out of stock
a product appears in an order only once
the order total is always the sum of its items
an empty order cannot be paid
cancelling an order puts its items back in stock
